title: Quarterly Federal Government Operating Expenditure by Object
description: Breakdown of quarterly Federal Government operating expenditure into key categories.

fields.name: date
fields.title: Date
fields.description: [Date] The date in YYYY-MM-DD format, with DD set to 01 since the data is at quarterly frequency

fields.name: object
fields.title: Object
fields.description: [String] Variable name, to be mapped using the [Lookup Table](https://data.gov.my/data-catalogue/lookup_federal_finance) where file = 'oe'. The lookup table will give you the English and Malay definitions.

fields.name: value
fields.title: Expenditure (RM mil)
fields.description: [Float] Operating expenditure in millions of ringgit (RM mil)

methodology: This data is produced by the Accountant-General's Department in compliance with the [Malaysian Public Sector Accounting Standards](https://www2.anm.gov.my/akruan/Pages/MPSAS.aspx) and the IMF's Dissemination Standards. Within this dataset, operating expenditure includes grants and transfers (including refunds and write-offs) to state governments, public agencies and public enterprises.
caveat: Numbers may not add up due to rounding during derivation. Furthermore, data for 2023 are preliminary and are subject to revision in future releases.
